verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules, such as auto-rollbacks or alerts that fire actions, are a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, but the evidence pack does not document any capability to define such rules. Autotune's automatic explore/exploit allocation and real-time gate toggling are adjacent features, not user-defined event-to-action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
